description: The bar chart illustrates the percentage of correct responses for different categories of logical reasoning tasks, with each category represented by a horizontal bar. The categories, listed from top to bottom, are "No Hallucination," "Oriented," "Active," "Self-aware," "Rigorous," and "Correct." Each bar is segmented into two parts: a blue section labeled "Matched" and a lighter blue section labeled "Not Matched," indicating the proportion of responses that matched the expected answer versus those that did not. The x-axis represents the percentage of responses, ranging from 0% to 100%, with tick marks at 20% intervals. The "Correct" category shows a total of 100% with 99.00% matched and 1.00% not matched. The "Rigorous" category has 95.33% matched and 4.67% not matched. The "Self-aware" category shows 94.00% matched and 6.00% not matched. The "Active" category has 97.00% matched and 3.00% not matched. The "Oriented" category shows 97.33% matched and 2.67% not matched. The "No Hallucination" category has 55.67% matched and 44.33% not matched, with the total percentage being 1.67%. The chart visually emphasizes the high performance of the model across most categories, with the "Correct" category achieving the highest accuracy.
